english.title: Fail to comply with duty under s.790HA notifying company on ceasing to be PSC
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[were a registrable person]_
(B)_[were an officer of a registrable relevant legal entity]_

in relation to a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..),

(C)_[and]_
(D)_[which,]_

having knowingly ceased to be such and not informed the company of that cessation or the date of it, without reasonable excuse failed, when the material in the register that was available for public inspection did not indicate you as having ceased to be a registrable

(E)_[person]_
(F)_[relevant legal entity]_

in relation to a company, to inform the company that you had ceased to be a registrable

(G)_[person]_
(H)_[relevant legal entity]_

in relation to the company, and the date of the cessation within the required time limit
english.legislation: Contrary to section 790HA of, and paragraph 14 of Schedule 1B to, the Companies Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a person that was under a duty imposed by section 790HA of the Companies Act 2006 OR were an officer of a legal entity that was under a duty imposed by section 790HA of the Companies Act 2006
without reasonable excuse
failed to comply with it

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine. The maximum penalty on summary conviction may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022. Time limit for prosecutions:
None
